tips.title: Review with your doctor
tips.body: Effects and side effects are usually reviewed about 3 months after starting.

tips.title: Spotting in the first months
tips.body: Spotting is common in the first months, but tell your doctor if it continues or is heavy.

tips.title: Only with your doctor
tips.body: Start, stop or change the dose of any medicine only with your doctor.

tips.title: Resistance exercise
tips.body: For bones and muscles

tips.title: Brisk walking
tips.body: 150 minutes a week

tips.title: Relaxation practice
tips.body: 10 minutes, for hot flashes and sleep
